title: Hazel and the Language
author: Wendell Kavanagh
blurb: Jonah Joubert, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
